name: Sam bo luong
summary: A sweet soup of Hoa family and community life in Tây Ninh, the other sweet beside chè mè đen.
origin: Hoa kitchens in Tây Ninh. The cooking is Teochew and Cantonese in origin, adapted to local ingredients.
howToEat: Finish a Hoa meal with it, or with chè mè đen.
seoTitle: Sam bo luong in Tay Ninh
seoDescription: Sâm bổ lượng, a sweet soup of Tây Ninh’s Hoa families.
